meta.scope: Operational and evidence readiness for a paid THI research product; this is not a claim that a betting edge has validated.

verdict.recommended_positioning: Paid college-sports research, model transparency, team intelligence and decision support.
verdict.prohibited_positioning: Do not market THI as a proven profitable picks service unless the prospective price-aware validation gate clears.

pillars.label: Prospective validation
pillars.summary: CFB has 9,049 immutable observations across 632 frozen games and 554 settled games. CBB automation is ready but has 421 settled 2027 spread decisions.
pillars.pass_condition: A full predeclared sample settles with complete price records, stability checks and corrected significance tests.

pillars.label: Exact market prices
pillars.summary: Existing CFB history has 2,923/9,049 opening snapshots and 93/266 near-kickoff captures with paired single-book prices. New CFB captures preserve them. CBBD exposes paired moneyline prices but not spread juice, so CBB ATS price validation still needs a two-sided sportsbook feed.
pillars.pass_condition: Every evaluated play stores one named book, exact line, both prices and timestamp at selection and close.

pillars.label: Predeclared validation rules
pillars.summary: The production validator requires a per-play no-vig baseline, exact or Poisson-binomial testing, Holm correction, outlier dependency checks and rolling stability. Signal Confidence measures the prospective evidence supporting each signal tier. Promotion requires a recorded per-play no-vig baseline, exact testing, Holm correction, outlier robustness, positive CLV and stable rolling results.
pillars.pass_condition: Rules remain frozen before outcomes are observed and every tested bucket stays in the correction family.

pillars.label: Operational proof
pillars.summary: CFB collection, closing capture and settlement are active. CBB platform health is healthy with 2,183 scheduled games and 1,485 market observations; live CBB proof begins when books post lines.
pillars.pass_condition: Complete a season with scheduled jobs healthy, no silent gaps, reconciled finals and published incident notes for material failures.

pillars.label: Paid-data rights
pillars.summary: CFBD/CBBD and The Odds API permit paid analytical products under their current terms while restricting raw redistribution. 3 active source-rights blockers remain: ESPN/Disney endpoints and ESPN-hosted assets, SportsDataverse/cfbfastR ESPN-derived datasets, School, conference, tournament, bowl, and broadcaster logos.
pillars.pass_condition: Maintain a source register, comply with attribution/redistribution limits and resolve every source-pending asset or field.

rights_register.name: CollegeFootballData.com / CollegeBasketballData.com
conditions: Commercial paid sites and independently created derived outputs are permitted.
Display only reasonable factual portions inside the larger THI product.
Do not expose raw responses, keys, bulk downloads, substitute feeds, or database mirrors.
The agreement does not grant third-party logo, trademark, player-likeness, broadcast, photograph, video, or audio rights.

rights_register.name: The Odds API
conditions: Commercial UI display, storage, research, and derived analytics are permitted.
The odds feed cannot be the primary standalone product and cannot be resold as an API, feed, or download.

rights_register.name: OpenStreetMap data
conditions: Commercial use is permitted with linked OpenStreetMap contributor attribution and ODbL notice.
Review share-alike obligations before distributing an OSM-derived database.

rights_register.name: OpenStreetMap Foundation public Nominatim service
conditions: Use only for low-volume build-time venue resolution, never customer-facing live geocoding.
Cache results, identify THI, retain attribution, and remain below one request per second.
Move to a self-hosted or contracted provider before paid traffic makes this a runtime dependency.

rights_register.name: TeamRankings
conditions: Do not scrape, store, derive from, display, or commercialize TeamRankings content.
The former coach ATS dependency was removed on 2026-11-11.

rights_register.name: ESPN/Disney endpoints and ESPN-hosted assets
rights_register.replacement: Licensed feed for factual fields and THI-neutral monograms for logos
conditions: Current consumer terms restrict commercial use, automated extraction, copying, and Disney intellectual-property use.
Do not enable paid access while ESPN endpoints, ESPN-derived production fields, or ESPN-hosted logos remain dependencies.

rights_register.name: SportsDataverse/cfbfastR ESPN-derived datasets
rights_register.replacement: CFBD/CBBD licensed data or another feed with explicit commercial dataset rights
conditions: An open-source package license does not automatically grant commercial rights to the upstream ESPN-derived dataset.
Do not place affected play-by-play, postgame, roster, FPI, or derived fields behind the paywall until the underlying dataset rights are documented or the source is replaced.

rights_register.name: School, conference, tournament, bowl, and broadcaster logos
rights_register.replacement: THI-neutral text and monograms unless a commercial mark license is recorded
conditions: Descriptive team names and factual references are handled separately from logo artwork.
No third-party logo may ship in the paid presentation without a recorded commercial license.
